answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with an open challenge bounty. Any participant may stake a small bond to challenge a suspect identity, opening its public vault of past work for independent audit. Reviewers check whether its skills, trades, and endorsements form a coherent ferrous backbone, not a thin opal veneer copied across many accounts. If fraud is confirmed, the fake loses standing and the challenger is rewarded; if baseless, the challenger forfeits the bond. One operator running many fakes must defend every challenge at once, making mass forgery costly and visible.
